day: Day 1: Travel from Delhi to Jaipur & Cultural Welcome
activities: Morning: Leave early from Delhi to Jaipur via car or train (approx. 5–6 hours).
Afternoon: Check into your hotel and relax. Enjoy Rajasthani snacks like pyaaz kachori or mirchi vada.
Evening: Visit Chokhi Dhani for a traditional Rajasthani village experience, folk dances, and authentic dinner.
Morning: Visit Amber Fort and enjoy views of Maota Lake. Explore Sheesh Mahal and Diwan-e-Aam.
Afternoon: Head to Jaigarh Fort and Nahargarh Fort for panoramic city views.
Evening: Stop by Jal Mahal for a sunset photo and lakeside walk. Enjoy dinner at a rooftop café.
Morning: Explore City Palace and visit Jantar Mantar, an astronomical marvel.
Afternoon: Visit Hawa Mahal and nearby local shops for handicrafts and block-printed clothes.
Evening: Stroll through Johari Bazaar and Bapu Bazaar for souvenirs. Enjoy local street food like ghewar and kulfi falooda.

day: Day 4: Museums, Gardens & Return to Delhi
activities: Morning: Visit Albert Hall Museum and take a peaceful walk in Ram Niwas Garden.
Afternoon: Try a Rajasthani thali at a local restaurant. Relax with some café time or explore Central Park.
Evening: Start your journey back to Delhi with beautiful memories of Jaipur.
